currentState.summary: Level 5 has room surface presets, but not a complete Level 5 v3 wall/floor/ceiling evidence chain matching the new furniture set.

runtimeOnlyImage2Floor.note: Existing older platform floor Image2 runtime hook is room-id based, not a complete builder surface preset family.

recommendation.reason: The 20 v3 furniture assets use a project-owned Image2 source-sheet art language: graphite, white ceramic, black ribbed pads, aged brass, cyan glass, and restrained red warning. Dedicated Image2 surfaces will look more coherent than generic CC0 metal/concrete scans.
doNotDo: Do not claim the existing procedural reclamation presets are the new v3 surface evidence.
Do not import CC0 without exact source URL, author, license page, local archive, and redistribution note.
Do not use the old room-fit platform floor as proof for wall and ceiling.

sourcePrompts: Tileable sci-fi reclamation core floor trim sheet: graphite metal plates, white ceramic lane inlays, aged brass seams, subtle cyan route lenses, black gasket grooves, restrained red warning slits, no text, no logos.

Tileable sci-fi reclamation wall panel trim sheet: vertical graphite ribs, white ceramic curved panel inserts, brass service bands, cyan glass inspection strips, screw caps, rubber gaskets, no text, no logos.

Tileable sci-fi reclamation ceiling panel trim sheet: recessed graphite service ribs, white ceramic baffles, cyan frosted light lenses, aged brass rails, black acoustic pads, tiny red maintenance markers, no text, no logos.
evidenceRequired: Copied source PNGs under repo-local image2 source directory
Generated cache path or tool call id when exposed
Official builder room env preset references

redistribution inside bundled web game allowed
